<span style="font-size: 2em;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Chen Ping’s Fourth

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: x-large;"><i>Advising Liu Bang to Grant Han Xin the Title of King of Chu</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
After Xiang Yu's death, and the rest of the Kingdom of Chu
surrendered to the Kingdom of Han, China was unified under Han rule.
Liu Bang, under the advice of Chen Ping, granted Han Xin the title of
(vassal) King of Chu. Han Xin's <u>loyalty</u> to Liu Bang was
further strengthened, and he was instrumental in helping Liu Bang to
overcome his rivals. Months later, at the urging of his followers and
vassals, Liu Bang declared himself Emperor and established Han as the
ruling dynasty in China [23].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Advising
Liu Bang to Grant Han Xin the Title of King of Chu </span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="font-style: normal;">is
an application of the 23rd stratagem, </span><i>Befriend
a Distant State While Attacking a Neighbor, </i><span style="font-style: normal;">and</span>
is associated with the 38th hexagram, <i>Fire
over Lake </i><span style="font-style: normal;">[1],
[28]</span>.</span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section51" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">certification: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">认证</span></span>:
	rènzhèng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to absorb: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">吸收</span></span>:
	xīshōu   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	sunlight: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">阳光</span></span>:
	yángguāng</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to glare (e.g. the sun is glaring): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">刺眼</span></span>:
	cìyǎn</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn154"></a><a name="tw-source-rmn162"></a></span><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">loyal:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large" lang="zh-CN">忠诚/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large" lang="zh-CN">忠心:
	</span><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">zhōngchéng/zhōngxīn</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
	  </span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to avoid: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">避免</span></span>:
	bìmiǎn</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	manager: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">经理</span></span>:
	jīnglǐ   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn76"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">management
	(team): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">管理者</span></span></span>:
	guǎnlǐ zhě&nbsp;</span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">annoyed: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">恼火</span></span></span>:
	nǎohuǒ   </span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	oyster: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">生蚝</span></span>:
	shēngháo   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to tie: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">扎</span></span>:
	zā   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to tie up: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">扎起来</span></span>:
	zhā qǐlái   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to attract: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">吸引</span></span>:
	xīyǐn</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-target-rmn3"></a><a name="tw-target-rmn4"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">to touch:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">摸</span></span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">触摸</span></span></span>:
	mō/chùmō   </span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to hesitate: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">犹豫</span></span>:
	yóuyù   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	value: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">价值</span></span>:
	jiàzhí</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn13"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">to be
	angry with...: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">生</span></span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">的气</span></span></span>:
	shēng...de qì   </span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to pay: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">付给</span></span>:
	fù gěi   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	awesome/severe: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">厉害</span></span>:
	lìhai</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	brave: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">勇敢</span></span>:
	yǒnggǎn</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to grab: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">抓住</span></span>:
	zhuā zhù   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	shining/flickering: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">闪亮</span></span>:
	shǎn liàng&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">necessary/required: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">非要</span></span>:
	fēi yào</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	not necessary/required: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不是必要</span></span>:
	bùshì bìyào&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">to share: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">分享</span></span>:
	fēnxiǎng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	coward: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">懦夫</span></span>:
	nuòfū</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	sign (e.g. a stop sign): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">标志</span></span>:
	biāozhì   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	Beijing: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">北京</span></span>:
	běijīng   equator: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">赤道</span></span>:
	chìdào</span></p>
</div><br>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 40:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section92" style="column-count: 2;"><div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
    1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我和那个公司面试的时候，主管告诉我学</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;历认证不是必要的。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这棵植物为什么有那么大的叶子？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">为了吸收阳光。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">因为阳光很刺眼，我没看到标志。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I didn’t see the
	sign because of the glare of the sun.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他们一直都在抱怨，这让我很恼火。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他在爬那么陡峭的山，很勇敢。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    6) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">他对他的老板很忠心。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">管理者一直都在避免做决定，都是懦夫。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你不要生经理的气。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">北京离赤道很远。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我喜欢吃生的生蚝。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不喜欢分享我的玩具。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">可不可以把这个袋子扎起来？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">今天晚上的星星很闪亮。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我在哪里可以给地铁卡充钱？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他还没付钱。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    16) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">我们最在乎的是忠诚度。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    17) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">别摸地上的东西，很脏！</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	18) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他突然抓住了我的手。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	19) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个小店吸引不了客人。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	20) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个东西有什么价值？</span></span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-39-chen-pings.html">Previous Chapter</a><span style="color: #333333;"> </span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-41-chen-pings.html">Next Chapter</a></p>
